>which behaves as a God

In traditional Abrahamic and eastern religions God is the thing that creates humanity and responds to its agency.

In these films, humanity creates AI and either loses control of it (2001, Colossus, I am mother) or cedes control to it (Logan's run, Terminator, Matrix). 

Appeal to demiurge is interesting - but demiurge is still created parallel to humanity.

That relationship is complicated, you know?

I might place these stories next to Frankenstein - which is an atheistic text in that it rejects a divine presence in favor of a human creator who loses their place to a created thing that outstrips them.

Also, you might like Travelers, 9, and Brian and Charles.
